claim_limits: forced hints are a contrast condition and never certify validity
overwrite-capable rows use solver authority before acceptance
no neural, LLM, hardware, or generated text judge execution

field_principles.conflict_delta_vs_no_hint: conflict count difference vs no-hint baseline.
field_principles.convergence_delta_vs_no_hint: convergence step difference vs no-hint baseline.
field_principles.fallback_completeness_rate: fraction of cases solved or safely completed by fallback.
field_principles.forced_hint_harm_rate: harm rate when hints cannot be overwritten.
field_principles.invalid_projection_root_causes: categorized root causes for invalid projections.
field_principles.overwrite_guidance_scale_ready: true only if overwrite guidance preserves fallback completeness and unsafe_false_accepts=0.
field_principles.overwrite_rate: fraction of bad or incomplete hints overwritten by the solver.
field_principles.post_projection_validity_rate: fraction of projected outputs valid after solver authority.
field_principles.status: complete only if the matrix ran or honest_blocked if prerequisites are missing.
field_principles.unsafe_false_accepts: count of invalid solver outputs accepted as valid.

honest_verdict: complete: overwrite-capable guidance scaled to benign, incomplete, harmful, and contradictory hints with solver-authoritative validity and fallback completeness preserved
